pdi_compatibility.evidence: The official tag's CMake source list and CSM main entry contain no PDI/ZMQ markers. The standard upstream executable therefore cannot yet be assumed to preserve the installed Gym-PDI protocol.
pdi_compatibility.required_before_runtime_gate: Identify and audit the exact project-specific PDI source integration for this runtime before building a Gym-compatible patched executable.
